Interpreter.title: Language is no longer a travel barrier
Interpreter.subtitle: From a full-day companion to an SOS button — transparent pricing from the start, never “call us”.
Interpreter.tiers: Four tiers for every budget and need
Interpreter.tier1Desc: Physical companionship for the whole tour or a full day — ideal for business, family and VIP trips. Clear daily rate.
Interpreter.tier2Desc: Just for one activity: a business meeting, a medical visit or market shopping. Right next to that service.
Interpreter.tier3Desc: A fixed “Call an interpreter” button — live connection in seconds, no booking needed.
Interpreter.tier4Desc: Key phrases in four languages + offline translation app tip. For travelers who skip the extra cost.
Interpreter.groupSizeHint: Equipment and interpreter count are auto-suggested from your group size.
Interpreter.profilesSub: Each profile shows languages, specialty and real traveler ratings.
Interpreter.kitSub: Six lifesaving phrases per language — plus our tip: install Google Translate offline (conversation mode).
Interpreter.sosSub: For sensitive moments: hospital, airport, police or a pricing dispute. No prior booking.
Interpreter.sosConnecting: Connecting you to a live interpreter…
Interpreter.sosNote: In Iran and Russia where international payment is hard, the fee is deducted from your iTrip wallet.
